The structure of Mg14Si2Pd2 (Mg7SiPd) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for Mg, Pd, and Si centers, each with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom; the Mg environments include Mg-only and mixed Mg/Pd/Si coordination. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show Mg–Mg 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibiting corner-, edge-, and face-sharing, while Mg–Pd and Mg–Si polyhedra share corners and edges. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 18 sites.
